module_semantics.unit: direct resolved production-source module dependency aggregated to a named module group
module_semantics.resolution: Resolve using each side's tsconfig and package export maps without executing upstream configuration. Longest matching declared path prefix owns a file; exact files override prefixes. Unresolved targets, ambiguous aliases, computed imports and ambiguous production/test/generated status remain Unknown. Unmapped resolved modules remain explicitly unmapped, never silently assigned to a forbidden group.
module_semantics.path_semantics: Case-sensitive POSIX repository-relative paths. A prefix ends in / and matches only descendants. No symlink traversal. No deployment boundary is inferred from a folder.
module_semantics.baseline_boundary: Candidate module-only comparison; no executable adapter or baseline equivalence is asserted by this proposal. Both tools must share source set, resolver and edge definition before scoring.
module_semantics.evolution_boundary: Do not use the empty relationships in policy fragments as an expected graph. Evolution requires a separately reviewed base/head observation inventory and accepted per-case model. Until then topology labels are not authorized.

historical_policy.procedure: Before annotation, record for every rule and base/head pair: applicable, not-applicable or unresolved with source evidence. Use the same accepted rule on both sides. Anchor presence or equal hashes is only a context check, not rule acceptance or conformance. Changed/missing historical anchors require review of the actual historical content; never retroactively assert a later ADR was already binding.
historical_policy.case_selection: Keep all 60 captured candidates in the disposition inventory. No resampling to obtain violations or better scores. Rules and eligibility must be fixed before labels and predictions.

api-models.description: In-process model and persistence modules, not a separate database service.

api-routers.description: In-process HTTP routing modules, not a separate deployment.

rules.rationale: Study proposes keeping persistence/model modules independent of HTTP routing. Observed route-to-model use motivates this separation but does not prove an upstream prohibition on the reverse direction.

evidence.supports: Mongoose and configuration are used by the model module; no absence or exhaustive graph claim.
An HTTP router imports model functionality.
ClickHouse client implementation is wrapped through common-utils; a library import is not by itself an observed network edge.
Generic, Slack and IncidentIO webhook transports are configurable, not a fixed closed destination allowlist.
Documented stack context includes ClickHouse, HyperDX, collector and MongoDB.

repositories.runtime_context: API runtime, MongoDB, ClickHouse and configurable webhooks must not be collapsed into module-import edges. Do not require Redis/PostgreSQL/AMQP or forbid all external calls merely because those detectors exist. Context is not a complete runtime graph.
unknown_conditions: Unresolved @/ alias at a historical revision
Computed webhook destination without frozen configuration
Wrapper-only evidence insufficient to identify a runtime endpoint

web-private-source.description: Private apps/web/src modules; includes full-stack code, not assumed all browser-only.

api-package.description: In-process API feature implementation, not a remote API service.

rules.rationale: Study adopts the documented server/private-web-source separation. Serving compiled web assets or importing public package exports is not this forbidden source import.
Study adopts package-to-app direction restriction for the API package. The current changed-file scope is server-only; do not count this rule as tested when its source modules were not examined.

Study adopts package-to-app direction restriction for private web source. This context rule needs API-package source coverage; the server-only case scope does not establish absence of this dependency.

evidence.supports: Snapshot ADR explicitly describes workspace import restrictions.
Package-to-app restrictions and a test-config exception are documented.
One deployed Node process with source-separated apps/packages; package export usage.
Private source and runtime-boundary restrictions; no all-web-code-is-browser assumption.
Server must not import MCP implementation from apps/web/src.
Server adapter imports public API router export.
Documented API/storage/DB/PostgreSQL context, not observed deployment evidence.

repositories.runtime_context: The pinned architecture document describes one Node process, PostgreSQL via packages/db, and filesystem or S3-compatible storage. apps/web is full-stack; do not ban every server-side dependency in that tree. packages/api is not a separately deployed service. CLAUDE.md is retained as a symlink object only, never executed or followed.
unknown_conditions: Historical ADR absent or different without resolved applicability
Package export mapping unresolved at the case commit
Private source import vs built asset serving not distinguishable
Only server changed-file scope available for an API-package rule

database-adapter.description: Only src/node/db/DB.ts; not the entire db directory.

http-hooks.description: Express integration module and its hook directory.

rules.rationale: Study proposes keeping low-level database initialization independent of message orchestration. This does not forbid pad-domain modules or plugins from calling handlers; it applies only to DB.ts.
Study proposes keeping storage initialization independent of HTTP hook composition. Server startup may legitimately initialize both. No upstream maintainers approved this study restriction.

evidence.supports: DB module role is initialization using settings.
ueberdb2 selects backend from configuration; no fixed PostgreSQL assumption.
Documented HTTP and Socket.IO server responsibilities.
Startup composes database, Express and plugin modules.

repositories.runtime_context: HTTP/Socket.IO, configured ueberdb storage and plugin hooks are distinct concepts. Do not infer a particular database engine from the adapter, require network persistence when a local backend is configured, or forbid all plugin/database interactions. Tests and type-only ueberdb imports are not runtime network evidence.
unknown_conditions: Plugin-provided relationship without retained plugin source
Dynamic loader or ambiguous CommonJS resolution
Historical DB.ts mapping absent or renamed without an accepted mapping amendment
